goal: Best current-time actual wave-field estimate from six pressures; quantify depth dependence
footprint_status: Comparison benchmark, not a limit on research
noise_status: Hypothetical independent white pressure noise; not a sensor specification
estimator_input: Timestamp + six absolute pressures, known hull/pressure calibration at the stated depth
prior_source: Learned only from first 1024 pressure packets; gamma=3.3 and separable JONSWAP/cos-2s family assumed
validation: Only first 1024 packets used for prior learning. Score subsequent samples; whole generated frequency band, no truth phase alignment or rescaling
known_limit: This prior learner does not fit a noise covariance; noisy/deep runs are stress tests, not claims of a noise-optimal estimator
